settings.heading: Every theme block.
settings.subheading: 102 blocks that drop into Block section, Product block section and the layout rows. The product template on this demo is built from them.

settings.title: Palette
settings.subtitle: Seven swatches
settings.body: Paper #F6F1E7, Ink #182E2A, Field #496440, Oxblood #793D43, Oat #E5D8BE, Mist #D5E0CD, Stone #62665E. WCAG 2.2 AA across every pairing used.

settings.title: Type
settings.subtitle: Two families
settings.body: Fraunces for headings, DM Sans for body at 17px and 1.65 line height. Letter-spacing on headings pulled in by one step. No uppercase buttons.

settings.title: Frame
settings.subtitle: Header One and Footer Three
settings.body: Header One with the Ink announcement bar and page-style search. Footer Three in the editorial layout with an Oat bottom bar. Dark mode off. 4px control radius.

settings.heading: Brand applied through settings only.
settings.subheading: Palette, type, header and footer are all Theme settings. Swap them and the structure holds.

settings.title: Contrast
settings.caption: Ink on Paper 12.6:1, Oxblood on Paper 6.9:1, Paper on Field 6.5:1

settings.title: Keyboard
settings.caption: Skip link, visible focus ring, operable drawer, tabs, accordions and gallery

settings.title: Images
settings.caption: WebP throughout, lazy loading below the fold, alt text on every image

settings.title: Weight
settings.caption: Two font families, no carousel library, section settings instead of custom CSS

settings.heading: Your brand, these sections.
settings.subheading: Everything on this site is available to any store running Quadratum. Swap the palette, fonts, menus and imagery in Theme settings and the structure holds.
